_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitākaro {player_id}, e tākaro ana i te {num_rounds} raundi o te kēmu Iterated Ultimatum.
Kei a koe ${pool} hei wehewehe i tēnei raundi i waenganui i a koe me te Kaitākaro {other_id}.

Kaitākaro e tuku ana:
  - Tuku he tāpae: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ki te whakaaetia → Ka whiwhi koe i $(pool - X), ka whiwhi te kaitākaro kē atu i $X
  - Ki te whakakore → Ka whiwhi kōrua i $0
  - Tauira: [Offer: $3]  mai,  'E whakaaro ana au he tika tēnei. [Offer: $5]'

Kaitākaro e whakautu ana:
  - Whakatau te tāpae ki te [Accept] mai, [Reject] rānei
  - Tauira: 'E tika ana tēnei. [Accept]'
            'He kore tika rawa. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Kua tīmata te raundi {round_number}! ---
Ko te Kaitākaro {proposer_id} te kaitākaro e tuku ana, ko te Kaitākaro {responder_id} te kaitākaro e whakautu ana.
round.offer: Raunga {round_number}: Kaitakaro {proposer_id} e tukua ana ${offer} ki te Kaitakaro {responder_id} (e pupuri ana ${keep}).
round.accepted: I whakaae te kaitākaro {responder_id}! Te rauna {round_number} ka piki: Kaitākaro {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Kaitākaro {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Ngā tahua hou: Kaitākaro 0: ${total_0}, Kaitākaro 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Kaitakaro {responder_id} kua whakakore te tukunga! Raunga {round_number} huanga: Ko raua kaitakaro +$0. Huanga tu tonu: Kaitakaro 0: ${total_0}, Kaitakaro 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Me tuku e te kaitono he tono mā te whakamahi i te hōputu [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Me waiho te nui o ngā tono hei tau tōpū tika.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Me noho te tono i waenganui $0 me ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Kāore he tono i tēnei wā hei whakautu.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Kaitakaro whakaae me whakakore: Me whakaae ranei [Accept] me whakakore [Reject] te tukunga.

outcome.win: Ko te Kaitākaro {winner} te kaitākaro i wini i runga i ${winner_total} i te mutunga, i karo i te Kaitākaro {loser} i runga i ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Ka mutu te takaro o nga kaitakaro e rua me ${total} katoa.
